reviews.review:
Phenomenal game that properly captures what videogames are about - fun.

Nothing makes sense, everything is entirely over the top, and the community plays along with the NPCs / narration in taking everything first degree, leading to impromptu absurd comedy inbetween waves of monsters and aliens.

4 classes with very distinct gameplay, hundreds of weapons to drop and upgrade, 111 missions base game + ~30 missions through DLCs, and higher difficulty tiers with actual challenge that will require you to pick your equipment, strategize and execute properly to pass the mission.

Hundreds of hours of genuine fun, absolutely worth full price, 10/10.

I may have gotten into this from 4.1 i will say EDF 5 is a great game and the things they added make each character a lot more enjoyable. For me the Wing Diver changes matter the most since I main her. Being able to dodge midair if very useful against ranged enemies but her over reliance on charge up weapons in comparison to EDF4.1 is a little challenging.


All in all a very good game that I would recommend to any arcade style game enjoyer.
Dumb fun game. And you don't need Epic Games to play online. :D
Got this to mix in with HD2 for a similar but different experience. The game is a bit clunky and super ugly but it's fun.

Great fun shooter, this does a good job with an extremely long campaign (100+ missions!) that progress the story and advance your char as you gain guns and gear and power to take on bigger and crazier aliens. I have not played previous titles, but enjoyed this one a lot and felt like I was playing Starship Troopers (the story, not the movie or the game which is still on my list to play). I would prefer a full first person shooter, but oh well. Game was bug free for me for the entire playthrough so yay for devs.

While I like the upgrade system, I was not a big fan of having to run around and pick them all up. Most missions I would get done with 99% of the critters, and then have to decide if it was worth spending 10 minutes running all around the map to collect loot or just end it. Since you really need the weapon + health upgrades for later missions, you really want to pickup them up as you will miss 95% of the upgrades otherwise.  The game is also annoyingly console centric design with multiple modal popup windows to quit and taking way too long to just start playing or quit playing.

Still - a lot of fun for SP use and looking forward to EDF6 and maybe trying Coop for that one.
